thread:
eva: quick sync - therewere three recent onboardings that passed bench but triggered user-facing regressions after exporters ran. looks like a gap between bench expectations and runtime porting. we should decide if this is a pipeline gap or exporter infra issue.

matt: saw the logs. most failures are small token shifts or broken special-token mapping once we move to onnx/tvm quant paths. took ages to trace.

lia: proposal: add a lightweight 'gatewire' stage between bench and ingest that runs small runtime parity checks across a reduced runtime matrix (fp32->onnx->tvm-int8). keep it bounded: N=40 prompts, 5 seeds for sampling models.

eva: good name. key constraints: <3min extra wall time, reuses warmed containers, stable serializer for diffs.

bench-bot: I can implement a gatewire job. plan: convert model artifacts, run canonical inference, produce token-id sequences + canonicalized text. serializer rules: NFKC normalization, strip zwsp, collapse repeated spaces, float logits rounded to 3 decimals. produce token-level BLEU and prefix-preserve check.

matt: thresholds? hard fail on token alignment mismatch >2 tokens or special-token id mismatch. soft warn if KL over samples >0.25 or token-bleu <0.88.

lia: semantics: hard fail blocks onboarding entirely. soft warn sets model to 'restricted-for-quant' with a clear flag in the console. restricted models remain available in hosted fp32 but won't be auto-quantized or used for cheap routing.

ops_bot: UI actions for restricted: badge + one-click "request quant review" which opens a remediation ticket with suggested exporter params and links to diffs. also allow manual override by infra/ML with an acceptance note.

cedric: long-term thought: this feels like exporter infra breathing room. maybe we need a central converter service with standardized token-mapping checks so exporters can't silently remap ids. that would be a bigger refactor but would reduce ad-hoc fixes.

eva: agree. short-term = gatewire stage + remediation workflow. long-term = centralize exporter validation + signer for token IDs. add to infra roadmap.

bench-bot: canary idea: after onboarding if model is restricted but team requests quant, enable a probabilistic canary: 0.5% traffic to quant path for 24h with verbose token-diff logging and automatic rollback on spike/error. will add runbook for thresholds (error rate + perplexity delta).

matt: we should also surface a compact token-diff snippet in the ingest page so engineers can triage without downloading artifacts. maybe first-line summary + top 3 mismatched prompts.

lia: will draft RFC follow-up that defines: gatewire stage name, serializer spec, thresholds, restricted flag behavior, canary policy, and ticket templates. tagging @bench-bot for job impl and @ops_bot for console actions.

eva: tagging followups: @cedric for exporter-refactor discussion, @matt for thresholds, @lia for RFC. I'll post the draft in #eng-ml and schedule a 30-min sync if needed. thanks all :thumbsup:
